rongmei.title: Chamdan latho lumv lou mei guay

lines: 1. Chamdan latho lumlou meiguai nian laritho,
Matat khatna khang de aniu guai panty hei
Kandih khouhei gaichuimei le Kaman kung mei
Matat khatna khourui man ngam puni.
Kandih akai aman ngam kansi ni
Kandih khouhei lung swang nimei kaibai meimak ,
Nban thaimei tingkao akai nai e.
2. Nang khang tiloumei sianlan ka-guaina rukhou,
Nang liantimei tan tei taan khang, ti twang ramc e;
Kandih khouhei ram khat sini, phung guang makge
Ram khat sini phung tat dat khang makge.
3. Zianmei khuan ruikao na bam the nian laritho,
Kandi khou Ravguangc rui rianra lakmei guai ta,
Lum loumei guay nakhang kazauzian tilou e.
Nrian loumei ramv khou phung guang louni.
